name: Auth.js
subtitle: Open-source auth library (formerly NextAuth.js)
creator: Iain Collins

version.label: next-auth v4 stable; v5 still beta

description: A library that runs inside your own app and handles OAuth sign-in with 80+ providers, magic links and credentials, with sessions stored as JWTs or in your database. Maintenance passed to the Better Auth team in September 2025, and they recommend Better Auth for new projects.
useCases: Next.js and SvelteKit apps with social login
Teams that want user data in their own database

concepts.explanation: OAuth, OIDC, email and credentials sign-in.
Store users and sessions via Prisma, Drizzle and others.
Customize jwt, session and signIn behavior.
Read the session on the server.

codeSamples.label: TypeScript · Next.js

cons: No built-in UI, MFA or organizations

pricing.summary: Free and open source. No hosted service or per-user fees.
